$schema_note: Cloudflare Custom Rules (WAF) for factory.lvlltd.com Printify webhooks. Apply with scripts/apply-cloudflare-waf.mjs or paste into Dashboard → Security → WAF → Custom rules.
description: LVL Factory Printify webhook edge WAF

rules.description: Block oversized POST bodies to Printify webhooks (>512KB)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/printify/webhooks" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.body.size gt 524288)

rules.description: Block webhook POST without X-Pfy-Signature (enable after secret installed)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/printify/webhooks" and http.request.method eq "POST" and not len(http.request.headers["x-pfy-signature"]) > 0)
rules.note: Enable after PRINTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured and Printify sends signatures

rules.description: Block non GET/POST/HEAD/OPTIONS on webhook endpoint
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/printify/webhooks" and not http.request.method in {"GET" "POST" "HEAD" "OPTIONS"})

rules.description: Managed challenge high threat scores on Printify API paths
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/printify/") and cf.threat_score gt 30 and not http.request.method eq "POST")
rules.note: Does not challenge POST webhooks (Printify cannot solve challenges)

rules.description: Skip Bot Fight Mode interference on legitimate webhook POST
rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/printify/webhooks" and http.request.method eq "POST")
rules.note: Skip only aggressive bot products — rate limit is re-applied by Rate limiting rules below. Adjust products if CF plan differs.

rate_limiting_rules.description: Rate limit Printify webhook POST 60/min per IP
rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/printify/webhooks" and http.request.method eq "POST")

rate_limiting_rules.description: Rate limit Printify API GET 120/min per IP
rate_limiting_rules.expression: (http.host eq "factory.lvlltd.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/printify/") and http.request.method eq "GET")
